verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow orchestration platform, not an agent, so publishing workflows as MCP tools is a fair question for it and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any mechanism for exposing workflows as MCP tools. The Google ADK and Vercel AI SDK integrations and the AI orchestration messaging concern building agents on Temporal, not serving tools to external agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call
